limitations: Observed validation development data; no blind or test-set claim.
Train and validation image IDs are disjoint; patient independence is unknown.
Two paired training seeds; question/image bootstrap does not estimate full training-population uncertainty.
Train annotations are privileged experience construction, not autonomous localization.
Only visual attention adapters were trained; null/old-task targets came from training-only teacher-forced base distributions.
318 matched historical base responses are reused; no new base generations or validation distillation occurred.
Exact match and original labels are unchanged; clinical truth is not independently certified.
Small and uneven task/target groups are descriptive, not confirmatory subgroup successes.
All base/adapter comparisons use this matched HF backend; earlier SGLang scores are not training baselines.
